response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software craftsman with strong TDD/testing and systems background, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang across web, mobile, and infra projects. There is no evidence of Kotlin experience, only minor/dated Java exposure (robotic arms, mobile orchestration tooling years ago), no Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience, and no IDE internals or language tooling background — all core requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive, diverse engineering experience across many domains and languages
Strong testing/craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, authored testing libraries)
Demonstrated ability to take ownership of complex systems end-to-end
concerns: No Kotlin experience evident anywhere in resume
No Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise Java framework experience
No background in IDE internals, language tooling, or developer-tooling for JVM ecosystems

key_factors.factor: Lack of Spring/enterprise Java framework experience
No Kotlin or IDE tooling background
Strong general software engineering and testing craftsmanship
